regimeSub: Fed rate now 4.0% after Warsh's second 25bp hike; 2Y blows out to 4.74% as markets price extended tightening cycle.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh hiked 25bps to 4.0% (Sept 16-17) → policy rate now +25bps from yesterday's 3.75%, 2Y yield surges 7bps to 4.74% as market prices additional tightening despite 1.5% GDP
BOK under acute pressure as Korea-US rate gap widens to 100bps post-Fed hike → KRW weakens to 1384 from 1379, BOK signaling forced follow-on hikes to defend currency
Aug CPI 3.7% YoY (+20bps MoM) and Core PCE 3.3% lock in hawkish Warsh stance → 10Y breaches 5.01% (19-year high), real rates grinding higher as inflation persists above target
Brent eases to $104.14 from $105.76 but Hormuz war-risk premiums persist post-June Iran ceasefire → energy pass-through maintains headline inflation pressure, constraining Fed pivot options

headline: Warsh's Fed delivers second consecutive 25bp hike to 4.0%, triggering 2Y yield blowout to 4.74% and forcing BOK's hand as stagflationary macro with 3.7% CPI and 1.5% GDP locks in extended tightening cycle.
